register.labelEn: TURN OFF Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: TURN OFF 可以描述某人不再聽下去,也可以表示某事令另一個人失去興趣。；TURN OFF 可以表示駕駛者何時駛離一條道路,轉入另一條道路。；裝置可以自行停止運作,也可以由某人把它關掉。；這些用法常見於課堂、道路指示、科技、購物和日常對話。
register.summaryEn: TURN OFF can describe a person who stops listening, or something that makes another person lose interest. TURN OFF can tell a driver when to leave one road and enter another. A device may turn off by itself, or a person may turn the device off. These uses appear in lessons, travel directions, technology, shopping and daily conversation.
